label: input q at original position >= 4
explanation: Fires when the input token is q during the original (pre-<DEL>) phase at position 4 or later (fires on every such step, precision 1.0). Never fires on q at positions 0-3, on the delimiter, or anywhere in the copy phase (including when q is fed back as an input), and essentially never on any other token. Magnitude depends on how close the q is to the end of the original sequence: it is largest (~3.5, near max) when q is the last original token right before <DEL> (to_go=0), about 0.7 of max at to_go=1, and about 0.2-0.5 of max further back. So it looks like a late-position q-token detector whose strength tracks proximity to the delimiter.

issues: The predicate and the core label check out. Test split: precision 1.0, recall 0.9987, F1 0.9994, mass recall 1.0000. The 53 test misses are all at step 8 on non-q tokens, with activations of 0.01-0.02 of max and 0.0% of the mass. That is scattered noise. There are 0 false positives.
The claims of no firing at t=0-3, on the delimiter, or in the copy phase hold. The profile shows 0 activations in delimiter and copy phases (recall_idx >= 0 all zero) and 0 at t<4.
The magnitude claim is wrong. Magnitude grows with absolute position t, not with to_go (closeness to <DEL>). The two are confounded because the top examples are all L=9 with q at t=8.

Evidence for the magnitude error, part 1: q at t==4 with to_go==0 (that is, L=5, q is the last original token) has quartile coverage [0.197, 0.064, 0, 0]. It sits entirely in the bottom two quartiles, not 'near max ~3.5'.
Evidence for the magnitude error, part 2: q at t==8 has quartile coverage [0, 0, 0, 0.264], entirely in the top quartile. q at t==4 has [0.995, 0.338, 0, 0], all low regardless of to_go.

Evidence for the magnitude error, part 3: examples in the profile. '2 f w y [q:0.21] a [q:0.69] <DEL>' (to_go=0 gives only 0.69). 'q r x 0 s e [q:0.71] <DEL>' (to_go=0 at t=6 gives 0.71). 'i k k h [q:0.20] n x' and '2 f w y [q:0.21]' (t=4 gives about 0.2 whether to_go is 1 or 2). The rough scale is t=4 about 0.2, t=5 about 0.47, t=6 about 0.7, t=8 about 1.0.
skeptic.revised_label: input q at original position >= 4 (magnitude increases with absolute position t: ~0.2 of max at t=4 up to ~1.0 at t=8, independent of distance to <DEL>)
